name: Baer Farms
tagline: Baer Farms — Local Farm in Tremont, IL
description: Baer Farms is a CSA (community-supported agriculture) farm in 14197 Baer Road, IL. Members receive a season-long share of the farm's harvest, supporting local growing while getting fresh, seasonal produce. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
